_doc: Sand Creek Raceway through Lake Murray v4's engine — the fleet pilot (ledger 0078, Kevin 2026-11-03: "Lake Murray v4 should be what we build the rest from"). engine lm-v4: the loop assembler is tracks/san-diego-lake-murray/scripts-v021 (V021_SHIM, never a per-track copy) and the prep / exporter / spawn builder are engine-july (ENG=<dir>: the real tree, a scratch copy, or the snapshot tracks/san-diego-lake-murray/engine-july-snapshot with assets/textures beside it). The draft starts from Sand Creek 0.35.0's line as airoso's data stages left it (tracks/sand-creek/data: the OSM centrelines, osm widths, 3DEP), read by tools/lm_engine_intake.py; then Lake Murray's own draft and author steps that serve a lap with no side streets: the assembler, the fold weld (weld_mouths, mainline only), Kevin's lamp model, the bespoke buildings in place of the assembler's boxes. Ledger 0079 adds Lake Murray's dressing as chain steps: the buildings pipeline's blocks at the surroundings' real density (the port's wider ground), the crowns read off NAIP as TreeFX (treefx), the houses gate. 0.2.3 (ledger 0079): the free roam's 106 grid streets are in, through Lake Murray's junction steps (trim_connectors with route.connector_hosts and route.street_junctions, rebuild_loop_blend, weld_mouths, gap_mouths, verify_mouths): every street meets the lap, an arterial or another street at a welded mouth. The workshop is outside airoso and beside Lake Murray's.

sync_in._optional_doc: ledger 0079: the port's own inputs (tools/lm_engine_intake.py uses a port file the source track lacks): its wider 3DEP grid (lm_intake.heightfield port), the buildings pipeline's blocks and the crowns read off NAIP
